name: kotlin-quality
description: Risk-based Kotlin review agents for READMEs, tests, architecture, domain behavior, concurrency, API and data compatibility, security, builds, performance, resilience, and platform runtimes

interface.shortDescription: Risk-based Kotlin review across code, docs, and runtimes
interface.longDescription: Classifies a change, runs only relevant Kotlin specialists, verifies their findings, and reports evidence-backed risks across README quality, correctness, concurrency, compatibility, security, builds, performance, resilience, KMP, Android, and web. Ships sixteen agents plus a Codex installer.
defaultPrompt: $kotlin-quality:install-codex-agents install the Kotlin review agents into Codex
$kotlin-quality:kotlin-review perform a risk-based review of this change
